settings.title: ADB over USB
settings.description: Puts the USB port in device mode for a computer. While it's on, the port can't take phones (wired CarPlay/Android Auto) or USB drives, including a HMG-API rescue stick.

settings.title: ADB over Wi-Fi (hotspot, port 5555)
settings.description: From a computer joined to the car's hotspot: adb connect 192.168.0.1:5555. Anyone on the hotspot can use it, and this head unit's adb doesn't check keys.
